# stats2data <a href="https://sebastian-lortz.github.io/stats2data/"><img src="man/figures/logo.png" align="right" height="150" alt-text="stats2data logo"/></a>

<!-- badges:start -->
[![Lifecycle: experimental](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-experimental-orange.svg)](https://www.tidyverse.org/lifecycle/#experimental)
<!-- badges:end -->

We introduce the stats2data package: Nonparametric Data Simulation from Reported Summary Statistics.


## Usage

The method is available as R package and comprehensive ShinyApp.

### Web App

You can use the app at [https://sebastian-lortz.shinyapps.io/stats2data/](https://sebastian-lortz.shinyapps.io/stats2data/). Expect longer computation time compared to running the app locally.


### Installation

Install the released version from CRAN:

```{r install, eval = FALSE}
   install.packages("stats2data")
```

### Run

You can launch the ShinyApp locally by running:

```{r, eval = FALSE}
stats2data::run_app()
```

## Citation

Please cite `stats2data` if you use it. To cite the software, use: 

```{r echo = FALSE, results = "asis"}
print(citation("stats2data"), style = "text")
```

Or copy the reference information to your BibTeX file:

```{r echo = FALSE, comment = ""}
toBibtex(citation("stats2data"))
```
